idea_name: LSTM gated memory for non-Markov price sequences
mechanism: An LSTM block keeps a Memory stream updated by ForgetGate (sigmoid, 0=forget–1=keep), InputGate×NewContent (tanh), and OutputGate×tanh(Memory); Input data and Hidden state are concatenated into four fully connected gates so rare, time-stretched chart events that fall outside a fixed window remain available at the current step.
data_needed: OHLC/indicator feature window per bar; recurrent Hidden+Memory state across bars; fractal or next-state labels for supervised readout
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; Fractal_LSTM EA; ~HistoryBars×12 input features; 4 LSTM units
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit short-term memory sensor for non-Markov regimes where pattern latency varies—forget/input gate activations are themselves readable state about what history still matters.
quote: Recurrent neurons in neural networks have been proposed for solving this problem when working with time series. This is an attempt to implement short-term memory in neural networks, when system's current state is fed into a neuron along with the previous state of the same neuron.

mechanism: OpenCL kernels parallelize per-neuron feed-forward, gradient, and weight updates; no new market sensing construct beyond speeding the same fractal classifier.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 candlesticks; last 2 years training
why_new_for_mis: Compute acceleration only; no new regime/vol/liquidity/sequence sensing idea after full read.

mechanism: Adam maintains exponential means of gradients m and squared gradients v with bias correction to adapt per-parameter learning rates; improves fractal-classifier training vs SGD but is an optimizer, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 20 consecutive candlesticks; last two years
why_new_for_mis: Training hyperparameter method only; no sensing mechanism for MIS after full read.
quote: This family of methods enables changing of neuron learning rate during neural network training.

mechanism: Decoder-only stacked transformer blocks (CNeuronMLMHAttentionOCL) compute Q/K/V per token, mask future keys (Score=0 for k>q), SoftMax-normalize, Multi-Head Attention out, residual+normalize, then FeedForward; autoregressive masking forces dependence only on preceding sequence elements—suitable for bar-token sequences.
data_needed: Tokenized window of recent bars (EURUSD H1, last 20 candlesticks) as sequence units; QKV weight matrices per head/layer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; historical data of last 20 candlesticks; Fractal_OCL_AttentionMLMH (5 layers×8 heads) and v2 (12×12)
why_new_for_mis: Provides a causal sequence sensor: attention Score matrices over past bars are direct, inspectable dependency maps MIS can treat as lead–lag/regime-structure readings.
quote: GPT allows finding relationships only with preceding elements of the sequence, but it cannot look into the future. ... GPT resets attention ratios in the Score matrix for subsequent elements.

mechanism: CKmeans iteratively assigns each system-state vector (OHLC deltas + RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD over HistoryBars) to nearest of k centers via squared Euclidean distance, updates means, stops when cluster membership flags all zero; elbow of loss vs k (~100–500 on 15y EURUSD) chooses pattern count.
data_needed: Unlabeled HistoryBars×8 feature matrix over long history; OpenCL distance/assign/update kernels; optional saved means file
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; StudyPeriod up to 15 years; >92k states; k scanned 50–1000 step 50
why_new_for_mis: Treats unsupervised clusters as an explicit discrete regime/pattern atlas MIS can monitor in real time without labeled outcomes.
quote: Totally the model analyzed more than 92 thousand system states. ... the model managed to identify about 500 patterns.

mechanism: After a trained k-means model, one-pass KmeansStatistic aggregates labeled buy/sell/skip fractal flags per cluster into probability triples (zeroed if cluster count <10); GetProbability maps the live cluster id to those historical reaction probabilities without further weight updates.
data_needed: Trained cluster means; labeled target flags (buy/sell/undefined fractal) on a possibly shorter sample; c_aProbability buffer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 500-cluster model; fractal-before-third-candle task; ~30–45% reaction probability reported
why_new_for_mis: Separates unsupervised regime discovery from a thin statistical readout—MIS can attach outcome likelihoods to regime ids without re-fitting a supervised net.
quote: the use of this approach makes it possible to predict the market reaction after fractal appearance with a probability of 30-45%.

idea_name: Softmax of inverted distances as soft regime membership
mechanism: Distances to all cluster centers are max-normalized to [0,1], inverted as (1−d/m), then SoftMaxed so nearby centers dominate; the soft membership vector feeds a downstream perceptron instead of a hard cluster id.
data_needed: Trained k-means means; live state vector; KmeansSoftMax kernel output of size k
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 500-cluster pretrained model into 3-hidden-layer perceptron (kmeans_net.mq5)
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a continuous regime-membership sensor that preserves distance-to-prototype information lost by hard assignment.
quote: we can first normalize the distances in the range from 0 to 1. And then apply the Softmax function to "1—X".

mechanism: CPCA centers/scales features, forms covariance XᵀX/n, SVD-decomposes, keeps first k left singular vectors so cumulative singular-value mass ≥0.99, then projects new states through UR—yielding nearly uncorrelated compressed features for downstream models.
data_needed: Feature matrix (e.g. 8×HistoryBars OHLC+RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD); saved means/STDs/Ureduce; Reduce at inference
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 15y PCA train → 160→68 dims (~2.4×); perceptron fine-tune last 2y
why_new_for_mis: Supplies a deterministic, orthogonal sensing front-end that strips correlated indicator redundancy while bounding information loss—useful MIS preprocessor before regime nets.
quote: In practice, this number of columns k is usually chosen so that the value of the above ratio is at least 0.99. This corresponds to retaining 99% of the information.

mechanism: Apriori/FP-Growth find frequent itemsets with MinSup then emit antecedent→consequent rules with MinConf; anti-monotonicity prunes rare items—frames market features as co-occurring binary baskets rather than continuous regressors.
data_needed: Binary transaction database of co-present features; MinSup/MinConf hyperparameters
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Toy 10-transaction retail example in this part; trading application deferred to Part 19
why_new_for_mis: Introduces co-occurrence/association sensing of feature bundles—MIS can mine stable multi-indicator conjunctions that precede targets.
quote: the rules detected by the algorithms must be frequently encountered. ... To meet this requirement, all algorithms used to determine association rules have a minimum support parameter MinSup

idea_name: FP-Growth rules from binned indicators to buy/sell fractals
mechanism: CAssocRules bins each scalar feature into `sections` intervals, appends buy/sell fractal target bits, grows an FP-tree at MinSup, then Mining extracts only paths to buy/sell targets at MinConf into private rule trees; Probability maps a live binned vector to buy/sell confidences.
data_needed: Matrix of indicator/price features + binary buy/sell fractal vectors; sections, min_sup, min_conf
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same fractal-before-3rd-candle setup as prior parts (EURUSD H1 implied by series tests); assocrules.mq5
why_new_for_mis: Turns discretized market-state baskets into explicit if-antecedent→fractal rules—MIS can surface interpretable multi-feature regime→event sensors.
quote: Let us add a few target features to the training sample of historical data. The algorithm should find association rules which will lead to the formation of our target values.

idea_name: Autoencoder latent bottleneck as nonlinear feature sensor
mechanism: Encoder funnel (batch-norm → shrinking FC/tanh layers → 2-unit sigmoid latent) is trained so decoder reconstructs the batch-normalized inputs; latent activations become a compressed representation of the full OHLC+indicator window that retains far more info than 2 PCA components on the same data.
data_needed: HistoryBars×12 features (OHLC deltas, volume, calendar, RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD); reconstruction target = layer-1 batch-norm output
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; 15 years; >92k patterns of 40 candles; 480→2 latent
why_new_for_mis: Offers a nonlinear unsupervised sensing embedding of market windows—MIS can monitor latent coordinates as a compact state vector richer than linear PCA.
quote: the autoencoder is able to compress information from 480 features (40 candles * 12 features per candle) up to a two-element latent state while preserving 78% of the information.

idea_name: Successive latent-state difference as market-dynamics sensor
mechanism: Author proposes differencing consecutive autoencoder latent vectors (analogous to image object add/remove via latent deltas) to read the dynamics of market-situation change rather than reconstructing charts.
data_needed: Trained encoder; paired latent vectors at t and t−1 over the same feature schema
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 autoencoder context (proposed use; not separately backtested in article)
why_new_for_mis: Reframes the AE bottleneck as a change detector—MIS can treat Δlatent as a regime-shift/velocity sensor independent of price deltas.
quote: We will try to evaluate the market dynamics based on the vector of the difference between two successive latent states.

idea_name: VAE continuous latent with KL-regularized distributions
mechanism: Encoder emits mean and log-variance per latent feature; CVAE reparameterizes z=μ+σ⊙ε (ε~N(0,1)), decoder reconstructs; KL divergence to N(0,1) scaled by kld_mult forces a continuous latent manifold so nearby market states map smoothly instead of discrete AE holes.
data_needed: Same multimodal bar window as AE; encoder width 2× latent dims; kld_mult hyperparameter
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; last 15 years; vae.mq5 vs multilayer AE loss comparison
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a probabilistic continuous regime embedding—sampled z and (μ,σ) themselves sense uncertainty and interpolate unseen market states.
quote: let's ask our encoder to return not one discrete value for each feature, but two: the mathematical expectation (mean value) and the standard deviation of the distribution to which the analyzed source data pattern belongs.

mechanism: GUI copies first N layers from a donor .nnw with TrainMode(false), appends new random layers, saves a new model—tooling for reuse, not a market sensing construct.
